actual_request.prompt:
EDIT TARGET is image 1. Create one newly redrawn complete single animation sprite of this same bamboo archer girl. Image2 is original identity, image3 is approved material/painting style. Preserve image1 exactly in head, green eyes, closed-mouth gentle smile, dark brown high ponytail, jade/gold leaf hair clasp, pale ribbons, green/ivory/gold embroidered tunic and boots, front yin-yang buckle, complete long bamboo bow held by LEFT hand at chest height, quiver over RIGHT shoulder. Preserve all correct anatomy and equipment; only two arms and two legs. Fixed front-right three-quarter camera SOUTH-EAST, body faces down-right, both eyes visible; about2.4 heads tall and same full-figure size/position as image1. Keep upper torso very steady. Change the legs and hips into the requested REAL new walking pose with clear foot placement, modest relaxed walking, no high kicks. Newly render actual joint articulation; no translating/mirroring/copying the existing figure. Native square complete frame at least1024x1024, genuine transparent alpha, all hair/bow/boots uncropped, no shadow, background, text, grid, watermark or blur. Highest available detailed bright rounded Chinese fantasy style. ANATOMY: nearer leg emerges from the screen-left/near side of her shorts and is anatomical RIGHT; farther leg from screen-right side is anatomical LEFT. Do not confuse legs when they overlap. 
OPPOSITE CONTACT pose. Image1 already has the NEAR RIGHT boot at screen LEFT raised and the FAR LEFT boot screen RIGHT planted. KEEP THIS leg ordering. Now extend that FAR screen-RIGHT boot diagonally DOWN-RIGHT forward 9% of figureheight, straightening the FAR leg to heel strike. Keep the NEAR screen-LEFT boot back UP-LEFT behind the hip, its heel raised and toe touching ground. The near leg must slope BACKWARDS from visible near hip toward screen LEFT, not diagonally forward-right. Show its kneecap BEHIND the far knee. The farther forward shin must emerge from the far/upper-right shorts leg. Two completely distinct legs, nearer leg behind and farther leg ahead. No new camera angle, no mirrored bow, no third foot. This is a small relaxed walking stride, both feet in ground contact, no visible bottom soles.
